verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can schedule recurring tasks that run in the background. Users can review active, paused and completed tasks and recent runs in a Scheduled view. Scheduled tasks can also start from Gmail, Slack or GitHub events instead of a fixed cadence. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs run reliably, and detail on scheduling granularity (cron-style intervals or time zones).
